# Hansel Ramos (hansellramos)

> Senior Software Engineer with 18+ years of experience building backend-heavy web and mobile-connected software. Specialized in PHP/Laravel, with strong Vue.js and Angular frontend skills, and AI-assisted development as part of daily work. Based in Barranquilla, Colombia (UTC-5), working remotely with US teams.

## Focus

- Backend: PHP, Laravel, CodeIgniter, Symfony, REST APIs, MySQL, PostgreSQL, Redis
- Frontend: Vue.js 3 (Composition API, Pinia), Angular
- AI engineering: Claude Code, MCP (Model Context Protocol), Laravel Boost, AI-assisted development workflows
- Testing: PHPUnit, TDD, Playwright
- Currently pursuing an MSc in Artificial Intelligence at Universidad Internacional de La Rioja (UNIR)

## Selected work

- Disney / Appetize POS: re-architected a 1.5M-record nightly product sync into parallel Airflow jobs, cutting runtime from 12 hours to 3.
- Health Recovery Solutions: designed an 18-step AI-assisted development workflow, piloted with a team of 6; delivery speed rose 50% and it was adopted company-wide.
- Compliance CRM: led the rewrite of a legacy PHP 5 system serving 124 US small businesses into a Laravel API and Vue app, migrated with the Strangler Fig pattern and zero downtime.
- Travelia: designed and prototyped AI features embedded in the core product (proof of concept, under evaluation).

## Personal projects

- Sphinx (https://github.com/hansellramos/open-sphinx): self-hosted, end-to-end encrypted photo, video and file vault. Passkey unlock with WebAuthn PRF, encrypted HLS streaming decrypted in the browser. Vue 3, Node, Express, Prisma. AGPL-3.0.

## Availability

Open to senior remote roles in PHP/Laravel, Vue and AI-assisted development, working US Eastern hours.
